images.caption: The smokestacks of the Kingston Fossil Plant in Kingston, Tennessee, located in the Southeastern United States.  The 1000-foot (305-meter) stacks are a familiar site to drivers who frequent Interstate 40 in Roane County.  This view is from US-70, just west of Kingston in Midtown.

images.caption:
Detailed exhibit of the original design of the ash disposal area of the Kingston Fossil Plant (originally called the Kingston Steam Plant) in Kingston, Tennessee.  The December 22, 2008 dike breach occurred in the northwest corner of the ash disposal area (in the vicinity of Dike "E").  
Note: The exhibit covered two pages, and the dark area in the middle is due to the page fold.
